source: computed in-page by calling the game's own colour module (colour-*.js export g = polygonCapColor(guessFeature, answerFeature, isDark, colours)) and distance fn (index-*.js export $ = closest-border distance in metres); the globe is a three.js canvas so there is no DOM/CSS colour to read
scale: d3 scaleSequential domain [15e6 m, 0] over interpolateOrRd (light theme, colours=Default) or interpolateBuPu (dark theme); exact answer = 'green'; territories without a country = #BBBBBB
emojiRule: ratio = distM / 15e6; answer -> 🟩, ratio < 0.1 -> 🟥, < 0.25 -> 🟧, < 0.5 -> 🟨, else ⬜; rows of 8
